note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere (owner in comment). disable-model-invocation: true means this is a command-species skill — routing cases still document intent, but the model never auto-invokes it.

Connect me to the marshal that's already running for this repo.
